title: Course Schedule
kidExplanation: Courses with prerequisites. Can you finish them all without a cycle of requirements?

thinkingSteps.title: Brute force idea
thinkingSteps.body: For Course Schedule, first describe a slow but correct approach (often nested loops or rescanning).

thinkingSteps.title: Why it is slow
thinkingSteps.body: Count the loops. If work looks like n×n, say so. Google interviewers want that honesty.

thinkingSteps.title: Aha insight
thinkingSteps.body: The problem can be reduced to detecting cycles in a directed graph. We can represent the course prerequisites as directed edges between nodes (courses). If there is a cycle in the graph, it means we can't complete all courses.
